summary: Reference-only control-room ops-board specimen: three-pane dark bench with anomaly-first wing, tabular status board, in-place failure with retry, skeletons, and 375px collapse.

claims.claim: First view resolves the three-pane ops-board hierarchy with center reading column flanked by resumption and evidence rails at working density
Anomaly-first signature is in place: right wing promotes the newest-failure view with a mandatory labeled reason chip
Central status-board component renders kind/target/status/duration columns with tabular numerals, exit codes, and in-place expansion
Non-happy state persists in place: failed Bash row with inline retry plus staged skeletons for running tools, status never color-only
Console-tabular typography holds at working density: mono-forward trace and rails with proportional prose quarantined to summaries
Responsive rule collapses to a single column with drawer wings and pinned composer at 375px via media query, with reduced-motion fallbacks

Eligibility: specimen is reference-only, self-contained inline-CSS HTML judging hierarchy, signature, component language, and system potential only, derived solely from direction-control-room plus shared brief and constraints

decisions.choice: Specimen scope is proposed as run-local reference-only evidence for direction-control-room; no build, promotion, or canonical change is decided here.
rationale: Reference-only specimen; no build or promotion decided here.

risks: Specimen density may read as clutter on small renders; column discipline and capped prose are what keep it legible.
Amber and red status stops are lightened for AA on near-black but still need measured contrast audit in the build.
Pulse and single-flash motion are illustrative; the build must confine pulse to genuinely running rows with static reduced-motion twins.
Limitation: static reference-only artifact; drawer focus order, live-region announcements, and staged skeleton timing are represented as notes, not functional behavior.
